packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates with GitHub's auto-merge, which waits for the CI checks the master ruleset requires.
Require dashboard approval before opening major upgrade PRs.

Tombi follows a branch of the kjanat/tombi fork, which Renovate skips as a git dependency, so only lock file maintenance moves its commit in Cargo.lock. That updates every Tombi crate in one pull request, and merging it makes release.yml publish a release that can't be replaced, so it is merged by hand.
